dedupe_keys.name: global co2 uptake by cement materials accounts 1930 2023

description: A cement-carbonation research team publishes global model inputs and annual carbon-dioxide emission and uptake estimates for cement materials from 1930 through 2023. Zenodo supplies six files under CC BY 4.0, including clinker production, usage parameters, simulated uptake and emission results, uncertainty ranges and Python-related code. These tables can parameterise lifecycle and long-term emissions scenarios for cement-intensive infrastructure. Related catalogue data-gcp-cem-cement-process-emissions tracks cement process emissions, while this deposit additionally models carbon uptake after use. Coverage is global and historical, not measured carbonation at every concrete asset. A limitation is that uptake estimates depend on cement use, material lifetimes, exposure and model factors; confidence intervals represent the authors’ uncertainty analysis, not direct field error bars. The page directs users to the describing Scientific Data article for detailed methods. No workbook was downloaded or global carbon balance independently reproduced.
